name: Service Bus namespace
summary: Enterprise message broker with queues and publish/subscribe topics, dead-lettering and sessions, reachable only through private endpoints.
useWhen: You need reliable asynchronous messaging between services with ordering, retries and dead-lettering
You need publish/subscribe with filtered subscriptions
avoidWhen: You need high-volume event streaming or telemetry ingestion (use Event Hubs)
You need lightweight reactive event routing (use Event Grid)
